questions.question: 500 persons are taking a dip in a cuboidal pond, which is 80 m in long and 50 m in broad. What is the rise in the water level in the pond, if the average displacement of the water by one person is 0.04 m³?

The breadth of pond, b = 50 m

The volume of water raised in pond = l × b × h

Average displacement by one person = 0.04 m3

Average displacement by 500 persons = 500 × 0.04 = 20 m3

Hence, the volume of water raised in pond = 20 m3

Now, 

The volume of water raised in pond = l × b × h

⇒ V = 80 × 50 × h

⇒ V = 4000 × h

⇒ 20 m3 = 4000 × h

⇒ h = 0.005 m

⇒ h = 0.005 × 100

⇒ h = 0.5 cm

Hence option 3 is the valid answer.

questions.question:
Determine the value of a and b for which the following system of equations has infinite solutions.

2x - (a - 4)y = 2b + 1, 4x - (a - 1)y = 5b - 1
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For **infinite solutions**, the **ratio of coefficients** must be equal: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂.

Comparing x-coefficients: 2/4 = 1/2.

Equating y-coefficients: (a − 4)/(a − 1) = 1/2 ⇒ 2a − 8 = a − 1 ⇒ a = 7.

Equating constants: (2b + 1)/(5b − 1) = 1/2 ⇒ 4b + 2 = 5b − 1 ⇒ b = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is a = 7 and b = 3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given equations:**

2x − (a − 4)y = 2b + 1

4x − (a − 1)y = 5b − 1

**Formula Used:**

For a **system of linear equations** a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ to have **infinite solutions**:

a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ a₁ = 2, b₁ = −(a − 4), c₁ = 2b + 1

⇒ a₂ = 4, b₂ = −(a − 1), c₂ = 5b − 1

⇒ 2/4 = −(a − 4)/−(a − 1) = (2b + 1)/(5b − 1)

⇒ 1/2 = (a − 4)/(a − 1)

⇒ a − 1 = 2(a − 4)

⇒ a − 1 = 2a − 8

⇒ 2a − a = 8 − 1 ⇒ a = 7

⇒ 1/2 = (2b + 1)/(5b − 1)

⇒ 5b − 1 = 2(2b + 1)

⇒ 5b − 1 = 4b + 2

⇒ 5b − 4b = 2 + 1 ⇒ b = 3

**∴ The correct answer is a = 7 and b = 3.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unique Solution Condition

A system of linear equations has a **unique solution** if the lines intersect at one point, which occurs when a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂.

No Solution Condition

A system has **no solution** if the lines are parallel and never intersect, which occurs when a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.

Coincident Lines

Infinite solutions occur when the two equations represent **coincident lines** (the same line), meaning one equation is a non-zero multiple of the other.</p

questions.question: Iodine is essential for the synthesis of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Thyroxine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thyroid gland:**

 
 
• The thyroid gland is known to be the **largest endocrine gland**.
 
• The thyroid gland is** a bilobed, high vascular organ**.
 
• The thyroid gland is composed of follicles (round in shape) and stromal tissues. 
 
• Each thyroid follicle is composed of follicular cells, enclosing a cavity. 
 
• **Iodine is an important constituent of Thyroxine because it regulates the synthesis of thyroxine in thyroid glands. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• **Iodine** (in diet) is essential for the **normal rate of hormone synthesis** in the thyroid. 
 
• Deficiency of iodine in our diet results in hypothyroidism and enlargement of the thyroid gland commonly called **goitre**.
 
• When the rate of synthesis and secretion of thyroid hormones is increased to abnormally high levels then this condition is known as **Hyperthyroidism**. It adversely affects the body physiology of an organism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thyroxine hormone has the following functions in humans:**

 
 
• They maintain the basal metabolic rate of the body.
 
• They promote the growth of body tissues and the development of mental faculties.
 
• They stimulate tissue differentiation.
 
• Thyroxine also controls the working of kidneys. Its deficiency results in decreased urine output and vice-versa.
